title: toechima erythrocarpum subsp. papuanum
intro: Toechima erythrocarpum subsp. papuanum, commonly known as the Papuan red-wood, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Toechima erythrocarpum subsp. papuanum include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
